blocks.2: In 1999 a committee of 3 members – Aage Sandal from Eivindvik youth society, Magnor Midtun from Gulen parish council and the municipal cultural officer, Svanhild Røkenes – was chosen to work on raising a memorial to Dahl at the parsonage, where he carried out his daily work. After a time Røkenes moved away from the municipality, and the new cultural officer, Øyvind Norstrøm, joined the committee in her place. After an open competition the stonemason Elisabeth Steen's proposal was chosen, and it was she who designed the memorial. The initiator and chair of the committee, Magnor Midtun, had the honour of unveiling the memorial stone, which was done before a large gathering at the house where Dahl lived, on a fine August day in 2002, 150 years after Dahl's death, with the following words:
